I've added tracing to the AI SDK call in `src/summarize.js` and turned on traces in `wrangler.jsonc`. I haven't run or deployed it: `ai` and `workers-ai-provider` are in `package.json` but not in `node_modules` or `package-lock.json`, so the Worker won't build until you run `npm install`.

**`src/summarize.js`**
- It now imports the whole `ai` module and passes it through `wrapAISDK` from `agents/observability/ai` (the tracing integration in agents 0.27.0). `generateText` comes from that wrapped version.
- I did this once at module level, so the call site is unchanged.
- Each call creates an `invoke_agent` span, plus a child span per model request named `chat @cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast`. The spans carry the model, Workers AI as provider, token usage, finish reason and the AI Gateway log ID when there is one.

**`wrangler.jsonc`**
- **`"observability": { "enabled": true, "traces": { "enabled": true } }`**: without this, Workers Observability doesn't collect the spans.
- **`"compatibility_flags": ["nodejs_compat"]`**: the agents tracer imports `node:async_hooks`. Your existing `Agent` code probably needs this flag too.

Optional settings:
- **Prompt and response text:** spans don't include them by default. Use `wrapAISDK(ai, { storeMessages: true })` to record them (`storeTools: true` does the same for tool calls). They're off by default because they can put user data into your traces.
- **Span name:** the top-level span is just `invoke_agent` unless the call has a name. In v7, passing `telemetry: { functionId: 'summarize' }` to `generateText` should rename it to `invoke_agent summarize`. I left it out because I couldn't check v7's types without `ai` installed.
